record.metric: ICE Brent and NYMEX WTI futures settlement prices in USD per barrel
record.observed_state: Nov2 Reuters reported futures settlements Brent $104.77/bbl and WTI $96.46/bbl, both sharply lower on talks-related expectations. Futures quotes are distinct from EIA physical spot; do not add percent changes or plot against incompatible providers/contract vintages.
IMO lists RITI as damaged in Strait of Hormuz on October 29. No pollution reported. The IMO entry does not identify an attacker or precise impact point; not a military equipment loss.

IMO records AL MAYEDA as damaged on October 30, about 40 nautical miles south of Lavan Island, Iran, with no pollution. An approximate location is not a qualified strike coordinate, and the perpetrator remains unidentified. This is merchant-vessel damage, not military equipment attrition.

IMO confirms LOUISE 1 (IMO 9290323) damaged on October 29 about 25 nautical miles northeast of Khasab. Reuters/UKMTO described attached explosive devices and an engine-room fire; the vessel later continued its voyage. No perpetrator identified, no exact impact coordinate, and not a separate new November 2 attack.

record.metric: IMO cumulative confirmed maritime incidents in Strait of Hormuz and wider Middle East
record.observed_state: IMO's source-specific confirmed incidents register reached 125 by Nov2, up from 122 at the Oct30 snapshot because three retrospectively confirmed October hull events were added. No assertion of three Nov2 attacks. Not additive to JMIC, UKMTO, Kpler, or IRGC attack totals.

record.metric: Primary OFAC Iran-related SDN designations and limited GL GG/HH
record.observed_state: OFAC designated five individuals, four firms and nine vessels linked to its Iranian shadow fleet action; GL GG and HH permit specific wind-down and safety/offloading activities. Counts are legal designations, not physical strikes, seizures or verified economic loss amounts.

record.metric: OPEC+ seven-state required production targets for December 2026 (policy, not production)
record.observed_state: OPEC primary decision reaffirmed September required production levels for December, seven participating countries. No basis to plot as actual barrels per day produced, global inventories, or November production delta.

OFAC sanctioned individuals and organizations connected to false maritime registries, aviation assistance and Iranian portable air-defense procurement. Treasury published a shadow-fleet false-flag advisory.
Treasury designated eight Canada-based money-services businesses facilitating Iran-linked transfers and digital-asset conversions.

record.metric: ICE Brent and U.S. WTI futures USD per barrel at 08:30 UTC
record.observed_state: Reuters reported Brent $96.67/bbl and WTI $89.87/bbl futures at 08:30 UTC November 9; Brent fell about 16% in the prior week.
Iran proposed negotiations within two days after U.S. sanctions and blockade relief. Rubio rejected Iran's stated preconditions.
Iran said two tankers struck mines and a third caught fire near Hormuz. Reports have not yet been matched to unique IMO hull identities in the accepted vessel ledger.

events.summary: Conflict Armament Research identified Chinese-sourced specialist components in shipments linked to Houthi efforts to manufacture missiles based on Iran's Kheibar Shekan design.
Iraq's parliament appointed Laith Hadi al-Khazali deputy prime minister on October 15. AP documented his ties to Asaib Ahl al-Haq and his U.S. sanctions history.
UKMTO warning 191 reported a vessel master relaying a second ship's Mayday call after a reported projectile impact in the Strait of Hormuz.

UKMTO published warning 192 on November 2. The incident was reported at 23:47 UTC November 1, approximately 72 nautical miles east of Ras al-Khafji, Saudi Arabia. The tanker reported two projectile impacts; its crew was accounted for.
The IMO's November 2 register listed 125 confirmed maritime incidents and 24 seafarer fatalities across the regional conflict, a cumulative total.
Iran proposed a conditional two-day Hormuz reopening arrangement. Doha mediation continued, and Reuters reported that the meetings ended without a breakthrough.
China's foreign minister spoke separately with Iranian and Saudi counterparts. Xi Jinping met Oman's sultan to discuss regional diplomacy and maritime navigation.
The International Organization for Migration reported more than 300,000 people displaced in Yemen amid renewed fighting.
Reuters reported November 2 futures settlements: ICE Brent $104.77 per barrel and U.S. WTI $96.46 per barrel, down 7.63% and 7.36% on the session.
IMO confirmed damage to RITI and LOUISE 1 on October 29 and AL MAYEDA on October 30. Vessel IMO numbers: 9249075, 9290323, and 9397298.
OFAC designated five individuals, four organizations and nine vessels in its October 21 Iran-related enforcement action, along with General Licenses GG and HH.
Seven OPEC+ states announced that December required production targets would remain at September levels.

OFAC announced new designations tied to fraudulent ship registries, aviation support and Iran's efforts to acquire portable air-defense weapons. Treasury also published an advisory on false flags used by Iranian shadow-fleet vessels.
U.S. Treasury sanctioned eight Canada-based money-services businesses involved in Iran-linked currency exchanges and digital-asset transactions.

Houthi health officials reported at least 30 killed and eight wounded in strikes at al-Hadara market, al-Waziyah district, Taiz. Houthi military officials blamed Saudi forces; Saudi responsibility was disputed.
Houthi-run health authorities reported 27 killed and 36 wounded in strikes near al-Shariya, northeast of Sanaa. Houthi officials blamed Saudi forces.

President Trump announced Task Force Iron Gate to restrict the movement of Iranian advanced weapons and sanctioned goods. He said further U.S. attacks on Iran were highly unlikely if talks progressed.

Iran reported two tankers striking mines and another catching fire near Hormuz. U.S. officials said they disabled a commercial vessel during a blockade enforcement operation. Reuters recorded the separate accounts.
Iran's Foreign Ministry defended a two-day negotiating proposal conditioned on U.S. sanctions and blockade relief. Secretary of State Rubio rejected Iran's conditions.
Reuters quoted Brent futures at $96.67 per barrel and WTI futures at $89.87 per barrel at 08:30 UTC November 9. Brent had declined approximately 16% during the preceding week.
